Ex-Sacred Heart University student gets 4 years, apologizes for Fairfield DUI crash that injured 6 Connecticut Post - 10/31/2025 09:00:00 AM The original article
A former student of Sacred Heart University, Tyler Delk, has been sentenced to over four years in prison for a DUI crash in Fairfield that resulted in serious injuries for six people. Delk was driving under the influence in 2023 when he collided head-on with an Uber. He pleaded guilty to the charges of driving under the influence and no contest to four counts of second-degree assault with a motor vehicle. In addition to his prison sentence, Delk has been given five years of probation.
NewsBreak Users Say
The news has sparked a diverse range of reactions from the public, with some expressing sympathy for Delk and others expressing outrage at his actions.
A number of comments empathize with Delk, acknowledging that he made a terrible choice but appreciating that he has accepted responsibility for his actions. These comments hope that Delk will learn from his mistake and never repeat it. Some of these comments also extend their prayers and blessings to all involved in the incident.
"For a young man that made a terrible choice he is accepting responsibility and is sorry. He will serve his time, learn and hopefully never do this again! God bless all 💕"
"God bless everyone involved. Heartbreaking. 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼"
On the other hand, there are comments expressing anger and frustration at the situation. Some readers feel that the punishment is not severe enough, comparing it to other cases where the sentence was similar despite the consequences being more severe. Others criticize Delk for his irresponsibility, labeling him as an entitled spoiled brat.
"The guy who killed my niece drunk driving only got 7 years and served 4. Nuts."
"Another entitled spoiled brat apologies my foot if you’re old enough to drive a car you should be responsible for your actions."
The public's stance on the news is divided, with some expressing sympathy for Delk and hoping for his reform, while others express anger and demand stricter punishment for such actions. The incident serves as a stark reminder of the dangers of drunk driving and the severe consequences it can have.
